data.name: Holiday Inn Express Oaxaca-Centro Historico by IHG
data.address: Diaz Quintas : 115, Centro, 68000 Oaxaca de Juárez, Oax., Mexico
data.description:
An 8-minute walk from the Jardín Etnobotánico de Oaxaca, this casual hotel is a 9-minute walk both from the Church of Santo Domingo de Guzmán and from the Museo de las Culturas de Oaxaca.
The low-key rooms provide desks, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, plus tea and coffeemaking facilities. Suites add separate living areas.
A breakfast buffet and parking are complimentary. There's also a terrace and an outdoor pool, as well as an exercise room. Other amenities include a business center and meeting space.
